title: Sea Life Centres & Aquariums
heading: Big eyes, strange creatures and a splash of wonder
intro: There is a whole world going on under the water. UK aquariums and sea-life attractions are full of things to stop, stare at and talk about afterwards. Browse the venue guides, pick a place that fits your trip and give yourselves time to enjoy it. If you are heading to the coast, add a promenade wander or somewhere for lunch nearby. An indoor sea-life visit can make a lovely part of the day when the weather has other ideas.
